title: Exodus wallet vault
whyItMatters: The Exodus wallet folder holds the encrypted vault with the private keys for all of the person's coins. With the password it is the money; without it, it still proves what they owned.
source: Exodus knowledge base, the wallet data folder is exodus.wallet inside the Exodus app-data folder: https://www.exodus.com/support/
notes: Encrypted storage.seco files inside. Timestamped archives of earlier vaults sit in a Backups folder next to it under %APPDATA% Exodus, so the parent folder matters too.
